metadata.description: Section-segmented corpus, evidence-linked study-metadata catalogue (52,400 records), terminology (162,409 canonical terms from NER models, LLMs and a MeSH gazetteer) and a versioned common data model (CDM 3.0.3, SQLite) for the 453 publications behind the BioProjects of the Human Microbiome Compendium (Abdill et al., Cell 2025). Every extracted value links to its source paper, section and character offsets. No human annotation was performed; values were extracted automatically and assessed computationally. Paper text and quotations are included only for the 274 CC BY / CC0 papers; for 179 papers text is withheld pending rights review, while identifiers, offsets and hashes are retained.
